_comment: 86,400 Seconds in the Life of a Cat — a time-and-motion study.
The one fixture whose conservation is physically meaningful: the flows are
seconds and they add to exactly one day, so a reader can verify the total by
arithmetic and any drift shows up as a wrong clock rather than an abstract
mismatch. That makes this the fixture to reach for when debugging the height
calculation by hand.
What the shape exercises:
- five columns with every location shared across all four postures, so the
overlap sweep and the gap carry-over both fire, at a size small enough to
check the golden by hand;
- four orders of magnitude inside a legible budget — two seconds of
successfully catching the red dot against six hours of sunbeam — so the
label drop rule fires without needing implausible numbers;
- several rows converging on 'doing nothing whatsoever', so link merging is
exercised on the largest node;
- the only order-sensitive dataset of the five, which is why it carries
`orderSensitive: true` — see the note below.
On order sensitivity: reversing this dataset's link list swaps
activity:knocking with activity:kneading and moves seven link bands. That is
worth understanding, because the obvious explanation is wrong. Input order is
the last of four tie-breaks (subtree size, then degree, then flow descending,
then input order), so one would expect it to need two sibling links of equal
flow — and this dataset has none. knocking carries 3,990 and kneading 4,200.
What actually happens is that the two nodes tie on subtree size (both reach
only outcome:destroyed) and on degree (two in, one out each), and because the
chain is implemented as a sequence of stable sorts rather than one combined
key, the residual order left by those tied sorts is the input order. Flow never
gets to decide.
That makes this fixture the one that pins the sequence-of-stable-sorts
structure: collapse the chain into a single combined sort key and this swap
stops happening. sourdough is the mirror image — equal flows, no sensitivity.
Flows are seconds and conserve to 86,400 exactly.
Regenerate the derived files with: node tools/generate_golden.mjs
title: 86,400 Seconds in the Life of a Cat
blurb: Five columns conserved to exactly one day, and the only dataset where input order changes the layout.
